Package com.yardi.shared.QSECOFR

Class EditPwdPolicyRequest

java.lang.Object
com.yardi.shared.QSECOFR.EditPwdPolicyRequest
public class EditPwdPolicyRequest extends Object
Container which holds all of the password policy elements that can be edited. This class serves as the data transfer object between the web and the application.

    • nbrUnique

      private String nbrUnique
      Enforce unique tokens. Enter a positive value to define the number of unique tokens to store per user. Enter zero if not enforcing unique tokens. Used to prevent password reuse.

    • maxSignonAttempts

      private String maxSignonAttempts
      The allowed number of invalid password attempts since the most recent successful login. When the number of unsuccessful login attempts reaches this number, the user profile entity is disabled and the user cant login until an admin resets the password. Enter a value greater than zero.

    • pwdMinLen

      private String pwdMinLen
      The minimum password length. Enter a value greater than zero to define the minimum password length.
